tagline: Nasdaq falls 5.28%; Russia kills 8 and hits Poland; Akvan lands

timeline.text: Cyclone Akvan makes landfall near Gopalpur after about 300,000 evacuations.
Iraqi forces begin taking positions at Jurf al-Sakhar under a militia deal.
Russian missiles hit three Kyiv bridges in a barrage that kills at least 8.
A Russian Kh-101 cruise missile hits a field at Nowy Lipowiec, Poland.
The Nikkei closes down about 5.1% as the chip sell-off sweeps Asia.
An overloaded funeral boat capsizes in Bayelsa; police later say 4 are dead.
The Nasdaq closes down 5.28% and the S&P 500 falls 3.7%.

stories.headline: Nasdaq sinks 5.28% as AI stocks plunge
stories.dek: The Nasdaq closed down 5.28% and the S&P 500 3.7%; Nvidia fell 14%.
stories.scene: A New York board in red: Nasdaq minus 5.28 percent, Nvidia minus 14.
stories.label: NASDAQ PLUNGE

stories.headline: Russian barrage kills 8 and hits bridges
stories.dek: Missiles hit 3 Kyiv bridges; Zelenskyy says at least 8 died in a barrage of over 400 drones.
stories.scene: Three Dnipro bridges, one closed, smoke, and rescue crews on the bank.
stories.label: KYIV BRIDGES

stories.headline: Cyclone Akvan makes landfall at Gopalpur
stories.dek: IMD says Akvan crossed near Gopalpur around 7:30 IST, after 300,000 were evacuated.
stories.scene: A grey cyclone over a flooded coastal road and evacuation buses at Gopalpur.
stories.label: CYCLONE AKVAN

stories.headline: Russian missile and drone hit Poland
stories.dek: A Kh-101 struck Nowy Lipowiec at about 05:30 UTC; Poland says 3 Russian weapons landed.
stories.scene: A crater in a Polish field, a farm camera still of the flash, NATO roundel.
stories.label: POLAND STRIKE

stories.headline: Saudi strikes hit Houthi sites in Yemen
stories.dek: AP reports strikes on Hodeidah and three governorates; Yemen says 193 Houthis were killed or hurt.
stories.scene: Night explosions over a Red Sea port and a tally marked 193.
stories.label: YEMEN STRIKES

stories.headline: Tanker catches fire off Hormuz
stories.dek: UKMTO and Iran's navy say 1 oil tanker caught fire off Khasab while transiting Hormuz.
stories.scene: A burning tanker in a narrow strait, with a UKMTO warning banner.
stories.label: HORMUZ TANKER

stories.headline: Funeral boat capsizes in Bayelsa
stories.dek: Police say 4 died and 24 were rescued; residents told Reuters at least 300 were aboard.
stories.label: BAYELSA BOAT
stories.scene: An overturned river boat, divers, and stretchers on a Bayelsa bank.

stories.headline: COP31 talks run into overtime
stories.dek: Nearly 200 countries passed Friday's deadline with fossil fuels still absent from the draft.
stories.scene: Delegates under a COP31 banner as the hall clock passes the scheduled close.
stories.label: COP31 OVERTIME

stories.headline: Italy stages a nationwide general strike
stories.dek: CGIL's strike ran through the working day, with marches called in about 100 squares.
stories.scene: Union banners filling a Rome square, with idle buses behind them.
stories.label: ITALY STRIKE

stories.headline: Iraqi forces enter militia stronghold
stories.dek: Nine officials were sacked; forces entered Jurf al-Sakhar, about 60 km from Baghdad.
stories.scene: Iraqi police vehicles entering a town long held by an armed group.
stories.label: JURF DEPLOYMENT

stories.headline: Haiti police say raid killed 34
stories.dek: Police say at least 34 gang members were killed in a raid in Port-au-Prince.
stories.scene: Armoured police vehicles on a Port-au-Prince street after a night raid.
stories.label: HAITI RAID

stories.headline: Japan core inflation rises to 2.2%
stories.dek: Core CPI, excluding fresh food, rose 2.2% on the year in October, below a 2.3% forecast.
stories.scene: A Tokyo price board for rice and fuel beside a chart at 2.2 percent.
stories.label: JAPAN PRICES

stories.headline: CBO warns AUKUS sub sales would hurt
stories.dek: Selling Australia 3 to 5 Virginia-class submarines would shrink the US fleet for years.
stories.scene: A Virginia-class submarine beside a US Navy tally with hulls marked as transferred.
stories.label: AUKUS SUBS

stories.headline: UK and EU near a 100,000 cap
stories.dek: The BBC says each side would take up to 100,000 young people a year.
stories.scene: UK and EU flags on a Brussels table beside a draft cap marked 100,000.
stories.label: YOUTH CAP

stories.headline: Two drones cross Moldova's airspace
stories.dek: ISW says 2 likely Russian drones crossed Moldova from Ukraine and then turned back.
stories.source: Institute for the Study of War
stories.scene: A map of Moldova with two drone tracks crossing in from Ukraine and back.
stories.label: MOLDOVA DRONES

stories.headline: BepiColombo nears orbit after eight years
stories.dek: The BBC says the probe has travelled almost 10 billion kilometres toward Mercury.
stories.scene: A twin-probe spacecraft approaching grey Mercury, the Sun glaring behind it.
stories.label: MERCURY PROBE

stories.headline: Malawi drivers queue overnight for fuel
stories.dek: A Blantyre driver paid about $17.31 for two litres on the black market, Al Jazeera says.
stories.scene: A night queue of cars at a Blantyre pump and a jerrycan at the roadside.
stories.label: MALAWI FUEL

stories.headline: Sudan war keeps 8 million from school
stories.dek: Al Jazeera, citing UNICEF, says at least 8 million children lack formal schooling.
stories.scene: A closed Khartoum classroom and a chalkboard with 8 million written large.
stories.label: SUDAN SCHOOLS

stories.headline: Africa counts $50 million in new cash
stories.dek: The Daily Nation says new Adaptation Fund pledges stood at $50.2 million.
stories.scene: African ministers at a COP31 microphone beside a pledge card of 50.2 million dollars.
stories.label: ADAPTATION CASH

stories.headline: China holds its loan rates again
stories.dek: The one-year loan prime rate stays at 3.0% and the five-year rate at 3.5%.
stories.scene: The People's Bank of China facade and a rate card stuck at 3.0 and 3.5 percent.
stories.label: CHINA RATES

stories.headline: India's Sensex rises as world slides
stories.dek: The Sensex closed up 2.3% at 83,920 while most major world indices fell.
stories.scene: A Mumbai board in green at plus 2.3 percent beside a row of red world indices.
stories.label: INDIA RISE

stories.headline: Taiwan stocks fall 6.63% on Friday
stories.dek: Taiwan's benchmark closed at 35,878, down 6.63%, in the global chip sell-off.
stories.scene: A Taipei exchange board deep in the red, chip names leading the fall.
stories.label: TAIWAN SLUMP

stories.headline: China warns against winter Fuji climbs
stories.dek: China's embassy warns against winter climbs as a family offers a $75,000 reward.
stories.scene: Snowy Mount Fuji, a missing-person poster, and a Chinese embassy notice.
stories.label: FUJI WARNING

stories.headline: Pill clears some pancreatic tumours
stories.dek: In a 61-patient trial, cancer became undetectable in 1 in 12 people given the pill.
stories.scene: A daily pill bottle and a scan with a tumour fading on a lab bench.
stories.label: CANCER PILL

stories.headline: Three Salvadoran soldiers die in Haiti
stories.dek: La Prensa Gráfica says 3 soldiers were killed and 1 injured when explosives detonated.
stories.scene: A Salvadoran flag beside a blast site and three helmets on the ground.
stories.label: HAITI BLAST

stories.headline: Trump delays decision on Iran strikes
stories.dek: Trump told Reuters he would discuss fresh large strikes after the start of 2027.
stories.scene: A White House podium and a map of Iran with a hold stamp across new strike marks.
stories.label: IRAN PAUSE

stories.headline: Court lets Venezuelan protections end
stories.dek: A US appeals court let the administration end, for now, protections for over 100,000 Venezuelans.
stories.scene: A courthouse and a stack of deportation files marked Venezuela.
stories.label: VENEZUELA TPS

stories.headline: Haiti and El Salvador plan prisons
stories.dek: The two governments agreed to build 3 prisons for Haitian gang members, AP reports.
stories.scene: A blueprint for three prisons stamped with the flags of Haiti and El Salvador.
stories.label: HAITI PRISONS

stories.headline: Gaza rescuers lose most of their trucks
stories.dek: Al Jazeera says more than 85% of Gaza Civil Defence vehicles are out of service.
stories.scene: A row of broken civil-defence trucks in Gaza, one hood open.
stories.label: GAZA TRUCKS

stories.headline: Students protest Iraq gender split
stories.dek: As many as 400 women have protested for 2 weeks after male professors were removed.
stories.scene: Students with placards outside a university gate, doors marked men and women.
stories.label: IRAQ CAMPUS

stories.headline: Boy, 11, dies after a Gaza strike
stories.dek: Democracy Now says Mansour Khader Nabhan, 11, died of wounds from a quadcopter in Jabaliya.
stories.scene: A damaged street in Jabaliya and a portrait of an 11-year-old boy.
stories.label: GAZA CHILD

stories.headline: Phillips out for 118 in Wellington
stories.dek: AP says Phillips made 118 in the first Test, a hundred in all three formats.
stories.scene: A batsman raising his bat at the Basin Reserve, the board showing 118.
stories.label: TEST HUNDRED

stories.headline: Rio Tinto pledges $370m for Panguna
stories.dek: ABC says Rio Tinto pledged $370 million for the Panguna mine's legacy in Bougainville.
stories.scene: A scarred open-pit mine in jungle hills and a pledge marked 370 million dollars.
stories.label: PANGUNA FUND

stories.headline: Sydney's ASX 200 closes down 2.6%
stories.dek: The ASX 200 fell 2.60% to 8,593, Yahoo Finance data for Friday's close show.
stories.scene: A Sydney exchange screen in red, the ASX 200 down 2.6 percent.
stories.label: ASX SLIDE

stories.headline: UN holds a straw poll for its chief
stories.dek: The Guardian says Grynspan led 7 of 8 straw polls before Friday's vote of the 5 permanent members.
stories.scene: A Security Council horseshoe, secret ballots, and a card for Rebeca Grynspan.
stories.label: UN BALLOT

stories.headline: One in four children live in war
stories.dek: Save the Children says 1 in 4 children live in conflict zones, and 2 in 5 in Africa.
stories.scene: A world map with conflict zones shaded and a caption of 1 in 4 children.
stories.label: CHILDREN AT WAR

date_check.item: Trump-Xi-Putin meeting and peace declaration in Shenzhen
Anthropic Nasdaq debut: priced at $83, closed up 17% at $97.17
date_check.note: Thursday 19 November. On Friday the stock fell about 8.5% in the wider sell-off.

date_check.item: Jensen Huang resigns as Nvidia CEO
date_check.note: 12 November. Friday's fact is the share drop, about 14%, not the resignation.

date_check.item: GTA VI launch and later sales estimates
ICJ ruling that Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya
date_check.note: Thursday 19 November. Friday pieces are reaction, not the ruling.

date_check.item: US Senate vote blocking an Iran war-powers resolution, about 48-51 or 51-48
date_check.note: Thursday 19 November. Friday briefs repeat it.

date_check.item: Daytime Russian drones damaging the Dutch and Austrian embassies in Kyiv
date_check.note: Thursday 19 November. Friday's story is the later barrage on bridges, plus the Poland impacts.
Capsize was earlier in the week. Not used as Friday news.

date_check.item: COP31 draft that drops fossil fuels and a $120 billion goal
date_check.note: The draft was published Thursday. Friday's news is that talks entered overtime with no gavel.

date_check.item: Nigeria funeral boat: 30 dead and about 300 missing
date_check.note: Wikipedia cites Daily Trust for that toll. Friday Reuters and Al Jazeera quote police: 4 dead, 24 rescued, residents saying at least 300 were aboard. The page uses the police figure.

date_check.item: Adaptation Fund country pledges (Spain $27.8 million and others)
date_check.note: Daily Nation says those amounts were the tally as of Thursday afternoon. The $50.2 million total is the Friday article's figure.

date_check.item: Israeli strikes in Lebanon reported in Friday roundups
date_check.note: FDD's 20 November brief attributes the Lebanon strikes it summarises to Thursday.

date_check.item: Iowa army blast of about 5 tons, Fiona the hippo, Adelaide insulin trial, Morwell incinerator, Darwin hunter, Cairns wreck, Bulandshahr raid
date_check.note: Left out. Several were Thursday, local, or too small for a world page.
Wikipedia dates that item to Saturday 21 November.

sources: Institute for the Study of War
